messages:
ops-bot: NIGHTLY PERF ALERT: kernel-selector & kv-cache panels p99 up ~22% over baseline in the last 2h. Spike start ~00:10 UTC. Affected: prod-us-east-1 dedicated pools. Link: https://dashboards/redwood/nightly/perf?panel=kernel-selector :rotating_light:

maya: saw it, thanks. did we have a release/merge around that window?

deploy-bot: release-note: PR 4820 merged to main at 23:45 UTC — "adaptive-batching-slew" (canary->prod roll started 23:50).

rick: noticed a CI perf job failure tied to that merge. perf-nightly job shows kernel_prober calls spiking. grabbing traces now.

juan: ran quick profile on canary (sha a1b2c3). Observed kernel probe count ~3x for short sequences (<64). It looks like the new slew heuristic is probing multiple kernels to find a throughput sweet spot, but it's doing that on almost every request due to a bad fast-path check. KV hotset churn increased, eviction rate +14% (evict/sec).

maya: if that's true it's likely causing tail latency via cache misses + extra kernel probes. can we reproduce locally?

rick: reproducing with perf harness:
```
# repro steps
make perf-nightly RUN=kernel-selector
./tools/trace --filter=kernel_probe --out=/tmp/probes.log
cat /tmp/probes.log | jq -r '.events[] | select(.seq_len < 64) | .kernel'
```

rick: bisecting locally — rolling back commit that introduced slew heuristics (commit b7f9d2) reduces p99 back to baseline in my runs.

sasha: can someone open a revert? if it's a behavior regression we should revert the rollout and then ship a tighter threshold fix.

juan: also saw the PR's perf test in pipeline flake on AMD runners (5/5 flaky runs), looks like probe ramp interacts with AMD kernel selection ordering. suspicious.

maya: action plan: 1) revert PR 4820 to stop the immediate regression, 2) add a regression assertion to nightly that checks kernel_probe_count per-request, 3) add an integration test for short-sequence batching + kv hotset. @rick you to open revert, @juan please add tests, @sasha hold the oncall rollback if needed. :thumbsup:

rick: opened revert PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-inference/pull/4899 (revert: adaptive-batching-slew). kicking canary.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback triggered for nodepool dedicated-04 at 01:10 UTC. Canary traffic reduced to 10%.

ops-bot: monitoring update: canary p99 back to baseline within 12 minutes of rollback. Continuing 30m observation window.

sasha: oncall here — I'll keep watch on evictions and kernel probe metrics. If anything creeps back up I'll pause promotion.

maya: nice work. after canary looks stable we'll promote and run a targeted perf suite against prod snapshots. follow-up: postmortem if regression reappears. closing thread once promote done.

rick: noted — I'll include perf traces and commit-level bisect notes in the revert PR description.

ops-bot: FYI alert auto-closed (canary stabilized).
